title: Not sure this is an actual air fryer
text: Not sure this is an actual air fryer. This could be a glorified toaster oven for all I know. I cant hear a circulating fan when I use it. It browns okay but they food doesn't seem to get crispy like it did in my old air fryer.  Still I use it for heating up frozen foods but it doesn't seem to work any better than a toaster oven. One big drawback-it has a timer dial but there are no numbers on it. I turn it halfway for half an hour but haven't timed it to see what the actual time is. Sometimes cheaper is not better.I could hear the circulating fan turn on when I used my old one, (it was a major company one). I don't think this one has one. There are pictures of a few food on top with cooking times but there is no actual timer. You cant turn it a quarter of the way for 15 minutes if this has a 60 minute timer. Don't know because there are no timer numbers, (not even raised bumps for time). Generally dissatisfied. Is easy to clean but definitely not easy to use. I will keep in and use it as a toaster oven but its a little too small for that.
